description: Fix Experience timeline circles to have black background and center alignment with timeline

stories.title: Make all timeline circles have black background
acceptanceCriteria: Remove white background (#fff) from circle styles
First-child special styling is no longer needed since all have same background
Visual verification shows all circles are black-filled

stories.title: Center timeline circles on the vertical line
acceptanceCriteria: Calculate correct left position: line center is at 9px (left: 8px + width/2: 1px)
Circle center must align with line center: left position = -(40px - 9px + 6px) = -37px
Visual verification shows line passes through exact center of all circles
Math verification: circle left edge at -37px, circle center at -37px + 6px = -31px, which aligns with line at -40px + 9px = -31px

stories.title: Verify changes work with hot reload
acceptanceCriteria: Vite HMR shows CSS update in console
Browser reflects changes without manual refresh
No CSS syntax errors in console
